narrative.overview: Venditores is the committee's own RAB (rencana anggaran biaya, the event budget sheet), already filled in. The landing page is that sheet: one large frosted glass panel with hairline ruled rows, a column header, a total row, and a closing approval block with Prepared by and Approved by lines. The in-app screens share the same palette and glass; the landing is the Persuade surface of that one system. The app screens were not redesigned in this run, so they carry the same tokens but not the sheet composition.
keyCharacteristics: One frosted glass sheet is the page; rows are hairline ruled, never carded.
Blue (#244CFF) is the live or active mark and the primary action, nothing decorative.
Display in Bricolage Grotesque, body and numerals in Onest with tabular figures.
Rows land one by one with a brief blue cell highlight; share bars draw in.
Light-only on the landing; the app has a dark theme through CSS variables.

rules.name: The One Live Mark Rule
rules.body: Blue means live, active or actionable. It never decorates a heading, an icon set or a surface fill.

rules.name: The Mark-Not-Hue Rule
rules.body: Row state is carried by a shape (check, ring, dash) plus a word. Do not add a status color per state.

rules.name: The Tint Rule
rules.body: No new hue enters the system; extend with tints of paper, ink and blue.

rules.name: The Tabular Rupiah Rule
rules.body: Every amount, share and score uses tabular-nums; totals and scores set in the display face.

rules.name: The Verb Ledger Rule
rules.body: Steps are large display verbs (Upload, Choose, Compare) with a small object line, in a ruled two-column ledger.

rules.name: The Frost Once Rule
rules.body: One glass layer per region. Nested wells use white overlay and a hairline, never another blur.

rules.name: The Mesh Rule
rules.body: Color lives behind the glass as radial gradients (never blurred blobs, which tile-edge in Safari).

dos: Do keep blue (#244CFF) to the primary action, focus, live marks and the Best badge.
Do show state as a mark plus a word (check Locked, ring Comparing, dash Not started).
Do set money, shares and scores in tabular-nums and align them in one shared grid.
Do build new surfaces from `.glass` over the mesh, with hairline rules at Ink 10% between rows.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion` by showing the finished state.
Do label example data as example on the page.
donts: Don't card the steps or rows; use ruled ledger rows inside a sheet.
Don't add a status hue per state or a second accent color.
Don't nest blur: wells inside glass use white overlay and a border.
Don't use blurred-blob backgrounds; use radial gradients.
Don't let the landing's hardcoded hex diverge further from the CSS variables.
